fields.description_en: Function code: bit 6 = request, bit 5 = FCB, bit 4 = FCV, bits 0-3 = function

fields.name: FCS
fields.description: Somme sur 8 bits de DA à FC

fields.description_en: Length from DA to the end of DATA

fields.name: DATA
fields.description: DSAP / SSAP si extension, puis données utiles
